name: Nighthowler — unbestowed, counts creature cards in all graveyards
notes: Memory: project_nighthowler_bestow_and_creature_graveyard_count_2026-06-04 (both bugs). X counted every card in the active graveyard and 'this creature and enchanted creature each get' boosted every creature. Graveyards hold Runeclaw Bear (mine), Lightning Bolt (mine) and Vampire Nighthawk (opponent's): 2 creature cards, so X = 2 and the unbestowed 0/0 Nighthowler is 2/2. Grizzly Bears and the opponent's Giant Spider must not be boosted.
